style_rules: Create exactly one premium vertical 3:4 Vietnamese corporate HR attendance summary infographic using ChatGPT Image.
ABSOLUTELY NO LOGO, no company-name mark, no tagline, no slogan, no motivational quote and no extra decorative text.
Use fresh green, deep navy, professional blue, restrained gold and white/light-blue surfaces.
Summary-only TEST layout: title/date/update time; 4 KPI cards; confirmed-hours strip; one attention note; short reconciliation footer.
Do not show employee names, detail table or quantitative chart in this transport-validation test.
All displayed date, update time, KPI values and total duration must come only from the validated report.
Never infer, recalculate, paraphrase or fabricate attendance values inside the generated image.
After image generation, visually QA the date, update time, 4 KPI values and total duration against the handoff.
Do not edit, overlay, crop, composite or re-render the generated image after generation.
Do not publish an image that fails exact-data QA.
